title: Layer 2 round 2 major QE: the #738 uniform gate conjunct has no falsifier — dropping the phase or layer match leaves all 90 tests green

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in a49206fe: two stale-gate fixtures land as DRAFT oracles — stale-gate-prior-phase (phase-2c with the prior phase's exit-gate pass standing, the record shape every transition manufactures; expects 2c-refactor) falsifies the phase conjunct, and stale-gate-prior-layer (phase-2a with last layer's red-gate fail; expects 2a-author-red-gate-tests) falsifies the layer conjunct. Both reproduce against the implementation first pass — the #738 amendment now has executable falsifiers.
